rate_limits.correction: Weight-based quotas reset every 30 seconds and vary by VIP level and resource pool. At global VIP0, Public is 2,000/30s, Spot/Margin is 4,000/30s, and Futures is 2,000/30s; public limits are IP-based and private limits are UID-based.

notes: Official docs are active and the changelog was updated in August 2026. The supplied docs URL redirects to /docs-new. The rate-limit characterization is false: public limits are not generally higher than private trading limits. KuCoin does not publish a clear standalone API pricing/free-tier policy, so both pricing claims remain unverifiable.
